authored.title: آمل أن

authored.explanation_en: Use I hope to for a desired future result that is not guaranteed.
authored.contrast_ar: I hope to pass أمل؛ I expect to pass توقع مبني على ما نعرفه.
authored.contrast_en: Hope to expresses a desired outcome without guaranteeing it. Expect to expresses a judgment that the outcome is likely.

authored.explanation_ar: نعبر عن توقع لنتيجة مستقبلية نرجحها بناءً على معلومات أو تقدير.
authored.explanation_en: Use I expect to when you think something is likely to happen.
authored.contrast_ar: I expect to finish توقع؛ I hope to finish أمنية.
authored.contrast_en: Expect to combines expect with a to-infinitive and usually presents a likely outcome. It does not mean the result is certain or necessarily desired.
